rows.text: Wacq Island on Vonwacq is one of the most biodiverse places in the universe. Unlike other islands, every creature here has a lethal gimmick. The Six-Toothed Flower is the weakest plant of the lot, as its teeth are only as hard as diamonds, and it hunts far slower than the average animal, nearly causing its extinction. Outsiders arriving on Wacq Island recognized the value of Six-Toothed Flowers and brought them to the Interastral Peace Market. After generations of selective breeding, the plant became both beautiful and safe, sparking a brief wave of hype. It's said its popularity comes from the realization people have while looking at it: In Vonwacq, you're nothing but a seed.
